subject: Mentors for project - 'Caffe Deep Neural Networks'

messages.author: f864da79ecbd36b9
messages.subject: Mentors for project - 'Caffe Deep Neural Networks'
parts:
Hi,

I am Daksh, currently in 4th year, pursuing my Integrated Masters of Technology degree(5 year B.Tech + M.Tech) at International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore. I have been actively working in the field of Machine Learning and Computer Vision as part of my coursework and have undergone courses at my institute as well as on many online platforms for the same. 

I am highly interested in working on the project - Caffe Deep Neural Networks. I have been working on Caffe, using its python layer for a course project on Restaurant photo classification(online challenge on Kaggle) and have tried and tested many of its pre-trained models. I have also worked on R for 2 years now, having used R for variety of tasks like data cleaning, data mining and text mining.

For this particular project, I am looking for two mentors, one expert in R and another in Caffe C++ code who could mentor me while am working on this project. I am highly motivated to work on this project as it is a completely new project for the R community and having Caffe interfaced with R would be a big boost to projects which require such sophistication.

Looking forward to replies from respected mentors.

Thanks,
Daksh Varshneya

messages.author: 29b2f428ea398f4f

parts:
Daksh,
   Adding Caffe DeepLearning support is a good idea. One possibility is to add Cafe as a framework in the deepLearnR package. I can be mentor in the R side, depending how the projects thrun out. 
Cheers
<k/>

messages.subject: Re: Mentors for project - 'Caffe Deep Neural Networks'
parts:
Ok, I read through the summary. Seems interesting enough. As per the project page I need to interface the original C++ code of Caffe with R. As you have used rPython and skflow to interface tensorflow, any ideas on what library I can use to interface c++ code. On a side note, I can even interface the python wrapper that Caffe has. What do you think about it?

Also, the project proposal says that I should write a new package. Would it be wrong if I develop it for your already existing deepLearnR package?

Lastly, what should I do to get a second mentor (Caffe expert)? I have already posted a query on the Caffe users googlegroups.
Should I just edit the wiki page to add you as the first mentor? Can I do that?

Cheers,
Daksh

messages.author: 29b2f428ea398f4f
messages.subject: Re: Mentors for project - 'Caffe Deep Neural Networks'
parts:
1. If Caffe has a rich C++ interface, that is the best way to go - using Rcpp 
  2. We used rPython because TensorFlow creates the graphs in the python layer and thankfully we found skflow. It worked out fine.
  3. Would be best if you can add the Caffe Framework to deepLearnR. You can add me as a mentor if you plan to work with the deepLearnR. If so, pl do the various exercises to make sure there is a congruence of skills and interest. 
Cheers
<k/>
